suggestions.title: Optimize LCP Image Loading
suggestions.description: The LCP image currently takes 4084ms to load. This significantly affects the loading experience.
suggestions.implementation: Ensure the image has high `fetchpriority` settings and adjust preload strategies using `createOptimizedPicture`.

suggestions.title: Defer Non-Critical JavaScript
suggestions.description: The `auth0-spa-js.production.js` consists of significant unused code (73%). It should be deferred or split to load post-LCP if applicable.
suggestions.implementation: Implement code splitting and defer loading of non-essential scripts post-LCP.

suggestions.title: Tackle Long Task Executions
suggestions.description: A 439ms long task caused delays post-LCP, which impacts interaction readiness.
suggestions.implementation: Use `requestIdleCallback` or `setTimeout` to distribute execution load.

suggestions.title: Improve Render-Blocking Resources
suggestions.description: Critical CSS like `styles.css` blocks rendering. Optimize CSS delivery by reducing critical CSS and deferring the non-essential styles.
suggestions.implementation: Move non-critical styles to `lazy-styles.css` and minimize `styles.css` content.
